anchors.source_excerpt: Er, it seems that while you were out, somebody else managed to bring me the ingredients. I've got no reward for you! Sorry about that, but when time is of the essence, 'first come, first served' is the only sensible policy.

This incredibly beautiful -- and powerful -- trident is made of the rare metal orichalcum. An amazing pearl is seated in head of the trident, as it spreads into three razor sharp prongs.
It is imbued with the greatest strengths of all of th
Increases all your summons' max life by %0.1f%% and extends your summons' maximum lifetime by %d turns.
Dispatched the Weirdling Beast and took possession of Yiilkgur, the Sher'Tul Fortress for your own usage.
Then you will die like Kyless. #LIGHT_GREEN#[Attack]#LAST#
Who knows what dark thoughts drive people to necromancy? Its art is as old as magic itself, and its creations have plagued all the races since the earliest memories.

observations.conclusion: 固定源码 dreadfell/npcs.lua（commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）：define_as=PALE_DRAKE，name="Pale Drake"，type=undead/subtype=skeleton；“亡灵”已由 type 表达，Pale 是专名修饰（苍白）。译文“亡灵德瑞克”把专名修饰改成种族类别。surface 与 contextual 两轮同因，确认。
源文关键词仅 capacity，译文“大容量”添加了“大”。仅表层一轮，记 advisory。
译文增补引号谚语“先来者先得”等，源文可见部分无法确证。仅表层一轮且交叉复核判 OK，记 advisory。

固定源码 temple-of-creation/objects.lua LEGACY_NALOREN 与 chats/slasul.lua（commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）：Naga 为现形态、Naloren 为族裔，imbued with the greatest strengths of Naga warriors；hope for all of the Naloren race, that one outside of their tribe could be so trusted。译文合并两专名并把“部落外人也可被信任”改成“只有你能受信任”。两轮同因，确认。
源文标签后尾随空格，译文丢失。单轮空白差异，按既定裁定记 advisory。
固定源码 talents（commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）：Increases all your summons max life by ...。译文“提升你所有召唤物的生命值”漏掉显式限定词 max（上限），可对照源码客观判定，确认。

固定源码 shertul-fortress/npcs.lua WEIRDLING_BEAST 与 quests/shertul-fortress.lua（commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）：name="Weirdling Beast" unique，desc=A roughly humanoid creature...with tentacle-like appendages。译文“异形触手”把具名人形 horror Boss 降为触手。两轮同因，确认。
固定源码 keepsake-meadow/npcs.lua define_as=KYLESS name="Kyless" unique 与 quests/keepsake.lua（commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）：“克里斯”为 Chris 常规音译，与专名 Kyless 不符。两轮同因，确认。
固定源码 init.lua load_tips（commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63）：its creations have plagued all the races since the earliest memories。译文“它的出现...带来了劫难”把 creations（死灵术造物）改成这门艺术的出现。两轮同因，确认。
